about_the_game:
The continuation of the dark story of Mikey and his friends.

The action takes place in a world with the red sun, hundreds of years after Mikey's rebirth. You will uncover the secret of the origin of the Reborn monsters, engage in conflict with the human race, touch upon the tragedy that befell the local inhabitants, and meet a group of hermits. The side you choose to support will directly influence the ending of the story.

Key Features:

  • The DLC offers enhanced features and combines elements of interactive gameplay in the genres of visual novel, point-and-click with item searching and inventory collection, as well as free movement across multiple locations.

  • To uncover the story, you need to explore the world and interact with its elements.

  • The action takes place in an alternate universe.

  • A sci-fi horror visual novel, point-and-click.

  • Multiple endings.

name: Metamorphosis: Victims of the red sun
short_description: The new story of the life of the reborn Mikey in the world of the red sun. Mikey broke away from the pack and turned into a true beast. He hunts, lives by instincts, and doesn’t remember his former self. Help him find his way again.
